about_short_description.short_description: InfiniLink operates as a semiconductor startup.

product.name: iOTC-G1 Optical Transceiver Engine
product.description: An optical transceiver engine designed for low power Ethernet and PCIe linear pluggable optical modules.

product.name: High-Speed SerDes
product.description: A range of high-speed Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) technologies for Ethernet, PCIe, chiplets, automotive, and AI applications.

product.name: Analog Transceivers
product.description: Analog transceivers for optical communication integrating TIAs, equalizers, VGAs, and optical modulator drivers for 100G and 200G optics.

product.name: Fully Integrated Silicon Photonics
product.description: Integrated silicon photonics solutions including modulators, wavelength division multiplexers, and fiber interfaces for scalable photonic transceivers.

product.name: Advanced Packaging for Photonics Chiplets
product.description: Advanced packaging technologies for co-packaged optics integrating photonics chiplets with electrical chips using 3D stacking and fiber attach.
